name: Dirk van der Meer
bio:
Dirk's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood visits to the Zandvoort circuit, where he was captivated by the roar of engines and the precision of the mechanics. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at Delft University of Technology, specializing in composite materials and manufacturing processes relevant to racing. After graduating, Dirk gained practical experience at a smaller racing outfit, honing his skills in fabrication, welding, and composite repair. He quickly earned a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and ability to work efficiently under pressure. 

Dirk's methodical approach and ability to quickly grasp complex technical challenges make him a valuable asset to Stewart-Haas Racing. He is particularly skilled at troubleshooting and finding innovative solutions to improve the performance and reliability of race car components. Dirk's calm demeanor and positive attitude create a supportive and collaborative work environment, allowing his colleagues to thrive even amidst the high stakes of professional racing. He is eager to contribute his expertise and contribute to the team's continued success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Dirk is a lean, athletic man with a focused gaze and perpetually grease-stained hands.

quirks: Always double-checks torque specifications, even on routine tasks.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on intricate parts.
Keeps a small collection of vintage motorsport posters in his workspace.
